coverage_complete_meaning: Gate A is limited selected-scenario evidence. Gate B requires the live bidirectional inventory joins and every requirement-specific semantic receipt/floor in mcp-native-coverage.json. Whole-test counters are diagnostics, never requirement evidence. Protocol wire and Tool domain schemas have separate validation. Neither gate grants blanket official certification.
